updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enabling organizations to block sensitive data sharing with untrusted cloud apps and generative AI platforms. This network-layer enforcement helps prevent data leakage through browsers, APIs, and add-ins without requiring per-app configuration.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience and Enhanced User Profiles
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now consolidates classic and agent-triaged alerts into a single dashboard with expanded user profile details from Microsoft Entra, including office location, employee type, and department. This unified experience simplifies alert triage and investigation while providing richer context for insider threat assessment.

updates.title: Azure Key Vault Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: CVE-2026-62825 involves improper authentication in Azure Key Vault that allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Admins should apply security updates immediately to prevent attackers from gaining elevated access to key management and secrets.

updates.title: Exchange Online Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: CVE-2026-56191 is an improper authentication flaw in Microsoft Exchange Online that allows unauthorized attackers to tamper with data and services over a network. Admins should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized modifications to email infrastructure and content.

updates.title: Azure DNS Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: CVE-2026-58275 is caused by missing authorization in Azure DNS, allowing unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. This vulnerability could allow attackers to hijack DNS resolution and compromise identity services reliant on DNS lookups.

updates.title: Online Services Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: CVE-2026-62835 is an improper authorization flaw in Online Services that allows unauthorized attackers to disclose information over a network. This vulnerability could expose sensitive organizational data and user information if not patched promptly.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Guided Diagnostics for Policy Troubleshooting
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is introducing a guided diagnostics tool that helps admins understand why DLP policies behave unexpectedly by showing which policies triggered, evaluation order, and condition results. E5 customers gain Copilot-powered insights and tailored recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting and policy optimization.

updates.title: Information Protection Auto-Labeling Capacity Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is increasing auto-labeling capacity from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day for SharePoint and OneDrive, enabling organizations to label and protect significantly more data at rest faster. This helps close labeling gaps and prepare data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Safeguard for Copilot External Web Search
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is expanding to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches, providing real-time controls to mitigate data leakage risks. This ensures sensitive information flagged by DLP policies cannot be used for web-based generative AI operations.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention for Copilot in Government Clouds
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot is rolling out to government clouds, preventing Copilot from responding to or grounding prompts containing sensitive data. This ensures compliance and data protection requirements are met in sovereign cloud environments.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention SLA Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is introducing an out-of-box dashboard for DLP alert SLA metrics (MTTA, MTTD, MTTR) that shows historical trends and top sensitive information types exposed via alerts. Admins can define custom SLAs for severity levels and monitor operational performance against these baselines.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Rule-Based Alert Auto-Resolution and Tagging
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is adding rule-based alert management that allows admins to automatically resolve predictable low-value alerts and apply tags for routing and categorization. This reduces triage queue noise and helps organize alerts by business context (e.g., trusted partner communications, department).

updates.title: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is extending sensitivity label support to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups, allowing the same labels used for Microsoft 365 groups and sites to apply automatically without separate configuration. This unifies classification and governance across identity and collaboration resources.

updates.title: Purview Adaptive Scope Lifecycle-State Evaluation Control
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes is adding explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, allowing admins to ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational changes (departures, role transitions). This improves governance accuracy for dynamic organizations.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Archive Support for SharePoint Retention
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLM is adding file archiving as a retention action for SharePoint Online, enabling admins to move inactive content to low-cost storage while maintaining discoverability and compliance. This extends retention policies beyond keep/delete to include archive, reducing storage costs.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLM is adding Graph API access to Exchange Online archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary), providing a unified view of archive data as EWS Graph APIs are deprecated by October 2026. This enables consistent API-driven management of archived email data.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Azure PST Import for Exchange Online
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLM is introducing Azure PST Import, which enables migrating PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using the standard Exchange Migration Service pattern. This provides a modern alternative to traditional network-based PST imports.
